about: A fixed observation log for the premise replay (#875). Two objects, two places. The step S_A (pick cup-7 from the desk) is modelled as a typing rule on cup-7's location; S_B (pick box-3 from the shelf) reads box-3's own location and is the unrelated control. observed_at is world time (the envelope's doc_time and the statement's `when` words); arrive_at is the replay clock, the moment the adapter treats as now after the event.

S_A.rule: S_A pick cup-7 from the desk
S_A.subject: A

S_B.rule: S_B pick box-3 from the shelf
S_B.subject: B

freshness.note: An explicit adapter-side policy, not a ledger TTL: a premise whose newest evidence is older than this pauses the step for reobservation.

identity.per_observation: every event is its own external_id (obs-<event id>); E6 re-pushes E4's content twice: once under E4's id with a later doc_time, once under a new id
identity.per_object: one external_id per object (its name), as suggested in the #875 reply; every push replaces that object's payload and records a version; E6 re-pushes the current payload with a later doc_time
